6.card: Bring drawings to life with 2D and 3D animation — from character motion to full animated sequences.
6.desc: This course spans both 2D and 3D animation, teaching you the principles that make movement feel real — timing, weight, squash and stretch — and the software to execute them. You'll animate characters and objects and build sequences you can show. It's a creative, hands-on foundation for a career in animation and media.

7.card: Create stunning interior and architectural visuals in 3ds Max — modelling, lighting and realistic renders.
7.desc: 3ds Max is the workhorse of architectural and interior visualisation. This course teaches you to model interiors and structures, apply materials and lighting, and produce the polished renders that win clients over. It's tailored for interior and architecture aspirants who want to sell a space before it's built.

8.card: Combine 3ds Max modelling with V-Ray rendering for photorealistic architectural and product visuals.
8.desc: This combo pairs 3ds Max modelling with V-Ray, the rendering engine that produces truly photorealistic images. You'll model scenes, then master V-Ray's lighting, materials and camera settings to render output that looks like a photograph. It's the complete visualisation skill set that architectural and product studios hire for.

14.card: Create cinematic visual effects and motion graphics in After Effects — the VFX standard for video.
14.desc: After Effects is the tool behind the title sequences, motion graphics and visual effects you see everywhere. This course covers compositing, keyframe animation, effects, and green-screen work, so you can produce polished VFX and motion graphics. It's a highly creative, in-demand skill for video and content careers.

16.card: Master vector design in Adobe Illustrator — logos, icons and crisp graphics that scale to any size.
16.desc: Illustrator is the industry standard for vector artwork — logos, icons, illustrations and anything that must stay sharp at any size. This advanced course covers the drawing tools, the pen, type, colour and building professional vector graphics. It's essential for anyone serious about graphic design and branding.

17.card: Design professional layouts in Adobe InDesign — brochures, magazines and print-ready documents.
17.desc: InDesign is where professional layout happens — magazines, brochures, books and any multi-page print work. This advanced course covers master pages, typography, grids, and preparing files correctly for print. It's a core skill for graphic designers and anyone producing polished publications.

18.card: Edit professional video in Adobe Premiere Pro — cutting, colour, audio and finished storytelling.
18.desc: Premiere Pro is the editor behind countless films, ads and YouTube channels. This course covers the full editing workflow — cutting and sequencing, transitions, colour correction, audio and export — so you can turn footage into finished, compelling video. It's a career-relevant skill for the booming video content industry.

24.card: Turn creative vision into a fashion career — a full diploma in fashion and textile design.
24.desc: This year-long diploma is a serious grounding in fashion and textile design. You'll develop design and illustration skills, learn about fabrics and textiles, explore garment construction, and build a substantial portfolio of your own work. It's built to launch a genuine career in India's thriving fashion industry.

27.card: Become an interior designer — a full diploma covering design, materials, software and real projects.
27.desc: This comprehensive interior design diploma takes you from design principles to professional practice. You'll learn space planning, materials and finishes, design software, and produce complete project work across the year. It's a career-focused programme for anyone wanting to design beautiful, functional interiors professionally.

28.card: Design fine jewellery professionally — a full diploma in jewellery design, sketching and CAD.
28.desc: This year-long diploma turns creative interest into a jewellery-design career. You'll learn design and rendering, gemstone and metal fundamentals, and jewellery CAD, building a portfolio of original pieces. It's ideal for anyone wanting to enter India's rich jewellery and craft industry with real, professional skills.

32.card: Become a complete web developer and designer — a full diploma from design to working websites.
32.desc: This advanced diploma covers both the design and development of websites over a full year. You'll learn visual design and layout, front-end coding, and building real, functional sites, tying it together with substantial projects. It's a thorough, portfolio-driven route into professional web work.

52.card: Model and animate in Blender — the free, powerful 3D suite used across the industry.
52.desc: Blender is a complete, free 3D toolset that professionals genuinely use, and this course makes you productive in it. You'll learn modelling, materials, lighting, and animation, building real 3D scenes and a short animated piece. It's a fantastic, accessible entry into 3D art and animation.

62.card: Design eye-catching graphics fast with Canva — social posts, posters and branding, no design degree needed.
62.desc: Canva has made professional-looking design accessible to everyone, and this short course makes you genuinely good at it. You'll learn layout, colour and typography within Canva, and produce social media graphics, posters and branded content quickly. It's perfect for entrepreneurs, marketers and anyone who needs great visuals fast.

84.card: Design intricate jewellery in Rhino 3D — computerised modelling for modern jewellery production.
84.desc: Rhino 3D is a favourite for detailed jewellery modelling, and this course focuses it entirely on jewellery design. You'll learn to model rings, pendants and settings precisely, and prepare designs for manufacture. It's a specialised, in-demand skill for the modern, tech-driven jewellery industry.

87.card: Master vector design and page layout in CorelDRAW — logos, brochures and print graphics.
87.desc: CorelDRAW is widely used across Indian design and print businesses for logos, layouts and signage. This advanced course covers its drawing tools, typography, colour and preparing artwork for print. It's a practical, immediately-employable graphic-design skill, especially for the print and advertising trades.

88.card: Render photorealistic architectural scenes with Corona Renderer — realism made approachable.
88.desc: Corona Renderer is loved for producing beautiful, realistic renders with a friendly workflow. This course teaches you lighting, materials, cameras and rendering settings to turn 3D scenes into convincing architectural and interior imagery. It's a valuable skill for visualisers who want quality without the complexity.

91.card: Create real-time architectural visuals in D5 Render — fast, GPU-powered photorealism.
91.desc: D5 Render brings real-time, GPU-powered photorealism to architectural visualisation. This course covers importing models, materials, lighting, environments and producing stunning stills and walkthroughs quickly. It's a modern, impressive skill for architects and interior designers who need results fast.

95.card: Master development and design together — a full year building complete, well-designed digital products.
95.desc: This year-long programme blends design sensibility with development skill, so you can both design and build digital products. You'll cover visual and interface design alongside front-end development, working through substantial projects. It's for those who want to be the rare person who can both design and code.

98.card: Train in animation, multimedia and design — a broad six-month diploma across creative media.
98.desc: This diploma gives you a broad grounding across the creative-media industry. You'll cover animation, multimedia tools, graphic design and video, building a varied portfolio that opens multiple career doors. It's ideal for creative people who want range across animation, design and media production.

99.card: Design interiors and architecture with real software skills over an intensive practical diploma.
99.desc: This interior design and architecture diploma balances design theory with hands-on software. You'll learn space planning, materials, and the CAD and visualisation tools the field relies on, producing real project work. It's a focused, practical route into interior and architectural design careers.

100.card: Design interiors and architecture with an Autodesk-certified diploma — software skills plus real credentials.
100.desc: This six-month diploma covers interior and architectural design with a strong software focus, backed by Autodesk certification. You'll master space planning, materials, and Autodesk tools like AutoCAD and Revit, building projects and an official credential. It's a career-focused programme with recognition employers value.

101.card: Become a 3D animation and multimedia specialist — a full year of modelling, animation and media.
101.desc: This year-long diploma is a deep dive into 3D animation and multimedia. You'll master 3D modelling, animation, texturing and rendering alongside multimedia tools, developing a strong showreel across the year. It's built to launch a serious career in animation, film and game media.

112.card: Master desktop publishing for print — layout and graphics for publishing and printing work.
112.desc: DTP is the practical craft behind books, brochures and every printed page. This course covers the layout and design tools used in publishing, preparing print-ready artwork, and the essentials of the printing workflow. It's a solid, employable skill for the print, publishing and advertising trades.

122.card: Render architecture in real time with Enscape — instant photorealistic visuals from your model.
122.desc: Enscape plugs into design software to give instant, real-time photorealistic renders and walkthroughs. This course teaches you materials, lighting, environments and producing polished stills and video from your architectural models. It's a fast, impressive visualisation skill for architects and interior designers.

135.card: Become a full-stack developer with PHP and web design — from front-end craft to database-driven back-end.
135.desc: This full-stack track combines web design with PHP development. You'll build well-designed front-ends, write PHP back-end logic, connect to databases, and ship a complete web application. It's a practical, project-driven route to becoming a developer who can build and style a full site.

136.card: Become a full-stack developer with Python and web design — beautiful front-ends, Python back-ends.
136.desc: This full-stack programme pairs web design with Python development. You'll learn to design and build front-ends, write Python back-end logic, work with databases, and deliver a full working application. It combines creative front-end craft with powerful back-end skills for a complete developer profile.

137.card: Build full-stack web apps with Python and Django — design, build and deploy complete projects.
137.desc: This extended full-stack track combines web design with Python and the Django framework. You'll design interfaces, build robust Django back-ends, manage databases and deploy complete applications across substantial projects. It's a thorough, portfolio-heavy route to genuine full-stack Python development.

138.card: Build modern full-stack apps with React and MongoDB — design plus a JavaScript-powered back-end.
138.desc: This full-stack programme pairs web design with React and MongoDB. You'll craft front-ends, build interactive interfaces with React, work with a MongoDB database, and deliver complete applications. It's a modern, in-demand stack that takes you from design through to a working, data-driven product.

144.card: Model buildings and spaces quickly in SketchUp — the friendly 3D tool for design and architecture.
144.desc: SketchUp is loved for how quickly it turns ideas into 3D models. This course teaches you to model buildings, interiors and objects, work with components and materials, and produce clean presentation views. It's an accessible, practical 3D skill for architects, interior designers and hobbyists alike.

145.card: Combine SketchUp modelling with V-Ray rendering for photorealistic architectural visuals.
145.desc: This course pairs quick SketchUp modelling with V-Ray's photorealistic rendering. You'll model spaces in SketchUp, then use V-Ray to add realistic lighting, materials and cameras for stunning output. It's the complete workflow for architects and designers who want both speed and render quality.

146.card: Become a professional graphic designer — a full diploma across Photoshop, Illustrator and real branding.
146.desc: This graphic design diploma is a complete creative education. You'll master Photoshop, Illustrator and layout tools, learn design principles, colour and typography, and build a professional portfolio across branding, print and digital work. It's built to launch a genuine career in design, whether employed or freelance.

173.card: Design jewellery in Matrix 3D — the specialist CAD tool for professional jewellery creation.
173.desc: Matrix 3D is a leading CAD tool built specifically for jewellery design. This course teaches you to model rings, pendants and detailed pieces, work with gems and settings, and prepare designs for manufacture. It's a specialised, industry-relevant skill for a modern jewellery-design career.

174.card: Master 3D animation in Maya — the software behind blockbuster films and AAA games.
174.desc: Maya is the professional standard for high-end 3D animation in film and games. This course covers modelling, rigging, animation and rendering in Maya, building the skills studios actually look for. It's a serious, career-focused course for anyone aiming at the top tier of the animation industry.

199.card: Master photo editing and design in Adobe Photoshop — retouching, compositing and creative work.
199.desc: Photoshop is the most important tool in any designer's kit. This advanced course covers layers and masks, retouching, compositing, colour, and creative effects, so you can edit and create images to a professional standard. It's foundational for graphic design, photography and digital art.

215.card: Design detailed jewellery in Rhino 3D — precise computerised modelling for professional production.
215.desc: This course focuses Rhino 3D's precision modelling entirely on jewellery design. You'll create rings, pendants and intricate pieces, working accurately toward manufacture. It's a specialised, in-demand skill that bridges craftsmanship and technology in the modern jewellery industry.

242.card: Master V-Ray rendering — turn 3D models into photorealistic images and visuals.
242.desc: V-Ray is the rendering engine that makes 3D scenes look truly real. This focused course teaches you V-Ray's lighting, materials, cameras and render settings, so you can produce photorealistic output from your models. It's an essential skill that elevates any 3D or architectural visualisation work.

245.card: Build real websites and design logos — a project-driven web design course with portfolio work.
245.desc: This course is built around actually producing work — real websites and logo designs you can show. You'll cover web design fundamentals, layout and styling, and logo and brand design, completing genuine projects along the way. It's a practical, portfolio-first route into web and graphic design.
